$comment: Which skills are baked into the HarnessRouter image, and which of those start switched on.
One folder per skill; the folder name IS the skill name and must match `name` here.
include         — copy this folder into the image at build time. false leaves it in the repo
for people who want it, and out of the shipped image.
default_enabled — a newly created Harness starts with this skill on. Never a promise it stays
on: a Harness can switch any built-in off, and that choice always wins over
A skill folder may declare what it needs, and the image build honours all three for every
apt-packages.txt  — system packages, one per line
install.sh        — anything else, run as root with network access at BUILD time only
